spec.description:
Foilboard Accessories comprise specialized installation hardware
and sealing components engineered to ensure complete thermal envelope continuity
and mechanical stability for Foilboard insulation panels. The range includes
aluminum foil joiner tapes, blanking plates, Floor Saddles, and Flexifast nylon
fasteners designed specifically to eliminate thermal bridging and maintain
non-destructive airspaces. These accessories ensure wall, ceiling, and
underfloor installations achieve rated system R-values and meet Australian
building compliance.
features:
Engineered specifically for Foilboard
rigid insulation panel systems

Eliminates thermal bridging at panel junctions
and framing fasteners

Reinforced aluminum foil tape creates continuous vapor
and air barrier

Durable, corrosion-resistant polymer and galvanized steel
components

Designed for fast installation in residential, commercial, and
underfloor applications

Prevents panel sagging and dislocation over the life
of the building

Tested for compatibility with EPS core and pure aluminum
facings
spec.fire:
Foil tape tested to AS 1530.2 Flammability
Index ≤ 5; Components compliant with NCC fire hazard requirements
spec.sustainability: 100% recyclable components; low VOC; zero ODP
install:
Position panels with
required 20mm+ air space to substrate

Fix panels mechanically using Flexifast
pins or Floor Saddles at maximum 600mm centers

Tape all panel butt joins,
corners, and penetrations with Foilboard 72mm reinforced foil tape

Firmly
squeegee tape to ensure permanent pressure-sensitive adhesion and airtight seal
selection_checklist:
Confirm Foilboard panel thickness to match
fastener/saddle length

Determine joist spacing (450mm vs 600mm) for saddle
quantities

Calculate total linear meters of panel joints for tape
requirements

Ensure substrate allows mechanical fixing of Flexifast pins or
screws
limitations:
Tape must be applied to clean, dry,
and dust-free surfaces

Do not substitute non-approved duct tapes that degrade
under heat

Saddles and fasteners are non-structural; do not support
mechanical equipment
spec.warranty:
Covered under Foilboard 25-year
performance warranty system

use_cases: Securing Foilboard panels between timber floor joists using Floor Saddles

Sealing panel joins with 72mm reinforced aluminum tape to form a continuous
vapor barrier

Direct-pinning Foilboard to masonry or concrete basement walls
with Flexifast anchors
retrieval.rag_summary:
Foilboard Accessories include 72mm reinforced aluminum foil
sealing tape, galvanized Floor Saddles, Flexifast polymer fasteners, and blank
plates purpose-designed for Foilboard insulation panels. They eliminate thermal
bridging, maintain designed reflective airspaces, and mechanically anchor panels
across underfloor joists, concrete slabs, and framed walls. Tested for thermal
and fire compliance, they ensure Foilboard installations achieve their rated
Total R-value and maintain long-term structural resilience.
